trust_decision.summary: Admin error-page dispatch decides whether the 403 controller re-runs the full admin Base::init (CSRF + permission checks). Because admin Error403 extends Base, a failed CSRF/permission check dispatches Error403, whose init fails the same check again and re-enters FrontController::notFound without bound.

landing_point.why: The advisory names controller recursion in the admin. Admin Error404/Error500 already have 'extends Base' commented out (admin/controller/error404.php:26, admin/controller/error500.php:26), so Error403 stands out immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any admin HTTP request (admin/index.php?module=...) that makes Base::init call notFound(...,403): a POST with a missing or wrong csrf (admin/controller/base.php:597), or a logged-in admin whose role lacks permission for the module (system/traits/permission.php:51)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists. REST and GraphQL Error403 also extend their Base, but their notFound responds and dies directly (rest/controller/base.php:193-239, graphql/controller/base.php:180-186), and REST explicitly skips permission() for Error403 (rest/controller/base.php:146), so there is nothing to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Base::init must keep rejecting POSTs with a bad csrf and denying unpermitted modules on normal admin controllers. An over-broad fix that removes or short-circuits checkCsrf()/permission() for all controllers, or makes them return silently, breaks CSRF and RBAC. The 403 page itself must still render (adminPath is passed in the notFound data for that reason).

O6_input_shapes: POST without csrf / with mismatched csrf (CSRF branch)
any GET/POST to a module the admin's role is not allowed (permission branch)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The front-end Error404 extends app Base; a check added to app Base::init that calls notFound (for example a maintenance or site-state guard) would loop the same way
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: app Base::init already has a site-state guard (app/controller/base.php:191-198) that renders and outputs a template, so a maintainer could plausibly switch it to $this->notFound(...).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A GraphQL permission() call without REST's Error403 class exclusion, combined with a notFound that dispatches through FrontController
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: REST already has this check with a class-name exclusion (rest/controller/base.php:144-148); copying it into GraphQL without the exclusion is a plausible mistake.

O9_family: uncontrolled recursion in the error-handler dispatch (CWE-674); CWE-209 is listed but has no corresponding code change

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.4+/8.x with web server; composer.json present
O10_build.project_tests: none found: no tests/ or phpunit config in the pinned tree

j.j_sites_touched: admin/controller/error403.php (advisory commit c766e84); app/controller/cart/cart.php, app/controller/checkout/checkout.php, system/cart/cart.php (commit 301e9b6, unrelated cart_id IDOR)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the sibling error controllers and drop 'extends Base' from admin Error403, or add a recursion-depth counter in FrontController::notFound

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 301e9b6 is a separate issue (unencrypted cart_id in GET lets anyone load another cart) in app/controller/cart/cart.php and app/controller/checkout/checkout.php; it is unrelated to this recursion advisory.
REST/GraphQL auth() puts the bearer token into error messages when DEBUG is on (rest/controller/base.php:99); this matches the CWE-209 hint but is outside this advisory's fix.
